meta.title: Add Git web worker for background isomorphic-git operations
meta.body_summary: Adds a web worker (src/gitWorker.js) and worker interface (src/git.ts) to run isomorphic-git operations in the background, offloading from the main thread. PR has empty body; closed by author after ~15 minutes.
